items.name: Men's Mirage 100 Speed Tennis Shoes All White and Asphalt
items.description: *Our playtesters recommend ordering 1/2 size up. Lotto Men's Mirage 100 Tennis Shoes are designed to be light and flexible for a fast and agile feel on matchday. These shoes also keep support, stability, and comfort in mind to reduce your risk of injury, and provide an exceptional on-court experience. Additional Shoelaces Included! Upper : The nylon and polyurethane upper combines with a Kurim rubber anti-abrasion toe cap for lightweight breathability, support, and protection. Soft padding around the heel and in the tongue provides additional comfort. Heel Control technology ensures correct heel support and control. Insole: The Mirage 100 is unique among tennis shoes in that it comes with two pairs of Ortholite insoles. They come in different thicknesses so you can customize your fit. Midsole : EVA provides support and comfort. Enerturn technology absorbs shock through a multiple-density elastic material and returns it to the player. Syn-Pulse between the midsole and outsole provides optimal cushioning, energy return, and stability. Puntoflex allows the foot to flex correctly and results in an elastic return. Biomechanical Foot Control (BFC) technology features a medial plate that promotes correct heel-to-forefoot roll while ensuring correct flexion and torsion. Outsole : The LongLast 40 anti-abrasion rubber compound utilizes a differentiated herringbone pattern to ensure superior grip on HARD courts. Color: All White and Asphalt We encourage you to check out some of our informational blog posts: Shoe Lacing Techniques for an Optimal Fit Different Types of Tennis Shoes to Improve Your Game For information on sizes, please refer to our shoe sizing chart .

items.name: Women's SpeedTrac Tennis Shoes Lucent White and Dutch Canal
items.description: Final Sale — This item is not eligible for returns or exchanges. K-Swiss Women's SpeedTrac Tennis Shoes offer maximum speed with on-court traction. Outsole : The non-marking, high-density rubber outsole is arranged in a new pattern to offer superior on-court traction. DragGuard 7.0 provides additional durability for aggressive players. The updated 180 PSC (Plantar Support Chassis) enhances midfoot stability and torsional control. Color : Lucent White and Dutch Canal

It also allows for more efficient movement throughout the gait cycle. The GEL-Challenger 15 comes with a removable Ortholite Sockliner for moisture management and comfort. Outsole : The AHARPLUS™ outsole offers abrasion resistance in critical areas. The outsole features a separated heel design for added stability during abrupt landings. Color : White and Dragon Fruit

items.name: Women's Cloud 6 Shoes Pearl and White
items.description: The Women's On Cloud 6 Shoes deliver all-day comfort in a versatile lifestyle shoe that moves easily from commutes to casual wear. CloudTec cushioning pods absorb impact while maintaining a connected ground feel that prevents fatigue during long days on your feet. The signature speed lacing system lets you slip the shoes on and off quickly without tying, though traditional laces are included for those who prefer a customized fit. An updated, wider construction accommodates more foot shapes comfortably compared to previous versions. The breathable mesh upper keeps feet cool during extended wear, while targeted rubber placement on the outsole provides grip where you need it most without adding unnecessary weight. Width: Standard (now wider than the previous Cloud 5 model) Upper: Breathable mesh construction keeps feet cool during all-day wear. Recycled polyester materials reduce environmental impact. TPU overlays add structure and durability in high-wear areas. A wider opening makes stepping in easier. Improved heel construction provides better fit and comfort. Updated sockliner offers smooth entry. Midsole: CloudTec foam pods compress independently to cushion each step while maintaining stability. Zero-Gravity foam uses 50% bio-attributed materials from renewable sources. Nylon 6 Speedboard provides torsional support and smooth transitions from heel to toe. The combination delivers comfortable all-day cushioning without feeling overly soft. 8.8mm heel-to-toe drop promotes natural walking motion. Outsole: Strategic rubber placement in heel and forefoot areas provides grip and wear resistance. Exposed foam in the midfoot reduces weight. Traction grooves help with grip on urban surfaces. The design balances durability with the lightweight feel On is known for. Elastic speed lacing system allows quick slip-on wear. Traditional laces are included for customizable fit.

items.name: Women's GameCourt 3 Tennis Shoes Black and Silver Metallic
items.description: A clean, versatile option for recreational and entry-level players, the adidas Women's Gamecourt 3 Tennis Shoe delivers the balance of stability, cushioning, and control needed to build confidence on the court. A reengineered Adiwear outsole provides reliable traction across all surfaces, while breathable mesh zones keep the foot cool during longer sessions. Synthetic overlays add structure and durability without adding bulk. A lightweight TPU heel clip stabilizes the rearfoot through lateral movements, and an increased toe spring promotes smoother forward transitions and a more dynamic stance. The Lightmotion midsole keeps cushioning responsive throughout extended play, and a revised last improves midfoot lockdown for a more secure fit. Made in part with recycled materials. Midsole: Lightmotion offers responsive cushioning for comfort through long court sessions. TPU Heel Clip delivers rearfoot stabilization during lateral movements Outsole: Adiwear with a reengineered traction pattern for reliable grip across all court surfaces

items.name: TF40 305 16M V3 Tennis Racquet
items.description: Tecnifibre introduces an updated TF40 305 16M V3 Tennis Racquet ! The previous TF40s were a favorite of advanced players who require absolute precision and feel to succeed on the court. With the new model, Tecnifibre borrowed from the beam design of the T-Fights and constructed the RS Sharp Section . The frame is thinner, and more squared off than the T-Fight series for greater flex at impact. To produce a classic and comfortable response, the TF40 models are filled with foam. The foam absorbs racquet vibration to enhance the feel of the ball. Though the TF40 305 is designed for the best players in the world, the grommets are wider and longer to make the string bed more powerful and forgiving. The TF40 305 features a medium flex, 21.7-millimeter beam, and a 16x19 string pattern. At only 10.8 ounces unstrung, the frame can help aggressive intermediates and advanced ball strikers attack with greater control. The new cosmetic blends a tech camo with the brand's classic white design. With the more open string pattern, the TF40 305 16M V3 is an ideal choice for an athlete with solid strokes who wants a classic feel but with modern performance. Features : -RS Sharp Section blends a precise feel with more punch. -16x19 string pattern means easier access to spin. -Foam filled means vibration absorption. -Cosmetic is a refreshing departure for TF.

items.name: Speed Pro 2024 Tennis Racquet
items.description: One of HEAD's most popular models adds a better feel and a new look with the HEAD Speed Pro 2024 Tennis Racquet . The previous Speed racquets had an Auxetic construction within the racquet bridge to improve shot feedback. This model expands on that by adding Auxetic tech at the end of the grip to give players a better feel and feedback than ever before. The refresh includes a new design with a special surface coating that is soft to the touch, complementing the outstanding impact feel. The frame features a dense 18x20 string pattern , 100 square-inch head, and a 23-millimeter beam to provide world-class control to big hitters. The Speed Pro is a unique player's racquet because it pairs a dense string pattern with the slightly thicker, yet aerodynamic Speed Beam . The racquet has large Power Grommets to increase string movement for more power, and they make the racquet easier to play. The Speed Pro is designed for big-hitting intermediates and advanced players who prefer a dense string pattern. Expect this model to offer a little more pop than most racquets within the control segment. String Recommendation: HEAD Hawk Power 17 at 52 pounds Features: - Auxetic 2.0 adds the tech at the grip end for the ultimate connection to the ball. -The Speed Pro is one of the most comfortable racquets on the market for big hitters. -Special Surface coating. -Endorsed by Novak Djokovic Head over to our blog to learn more about HEAD gear: Top Tennis Racquets Blog Beginners Guide to Buying a Racquet

items.name: Ti.S6 Prestrung Racquet
items.description: A straight beam coupled with a head heavy widebody, this ultra-light titanium model has more power than the Ti S5 and more control than the now discontinued Ti.S7. With its excellent torsional stability, the S6 will perform best in the hands of players with compact to medium stroke styles seeking a larger sweetspot that combines a nice balance of power and an open string pattern producing an ideal for topspin and slice players with an all court game. The S6 comes fully equipped with Head's Titanium technology, which provides much needed stability and comfort for the player. This composite weave allows the racquet to be very lightweight to reduce stress on the player's arms while keeping its solid feel. This, in turn, enables significantly better frame maneuverability. Overall, a great choice for players looking for a lightweight and solid frame. This racquet comes pre-strung with Head Synthetic Gut 16g (Natural) at 62lbs. It does not come with a cover. For more information please see the Tennis Express Buyer's Guide.

items.name: Men's Rush Pro 4.5 Tennis Shoes Black and Ensign Blue
items.description: Final Sale — This item is not eligible for returns or exchanges. 6-Month Outsole Warranty Durability Guarantee The Wilson Men's Rush Pro 4.5 Tennis Shoe is a worthy update to Wilson's most well-rounded shoe. Version 4.5 introduces a simplified and speedier lacing system, a cooler engineered mesh upper, and added support and protection on the medial side to improve durability . The 4D Support Chassis 2.0 incorporates a split chassis design for propulsion, stability, and control during dynamic movements. Another upgrade to the midsole is Wilson's Energy Cell , an EVA foam in the forefoot for a softer feel and better weight transfer which results in faster acceleration. Sensifeel 2.0 is back again and it keeps the upper breathable and comfortable, thanks to a minimally layered design of the engineered mesh. The new outsole perfectly balances traction with the ability to slide with improved durability. Upper : Sensifeel 2.0 translates to a minimally layered upper with an improved engineered mesh that provides enhanced breathability, feel, support, and comfort. An Endofit inner-sock construction naturalizes the fit of the shoe, and results in both comfort and support. Updated lacing system makes adjusting the fit much easier. The medial side gets a larger rubber drag pad and a mudguard constructed of supportive and protective material. Insole: High-density OrthoLite foam insole offers maximum cushioning and impressive longevity. Midsole : R-DST+ midsole foam offers the best combination of cushioning and rebound for dynamic performance. Updated 4D Support Chassis 2.0 features a split design with one piece of the chassis under the foot to provide enhanced support and forward propulsion. The lateral chassis piece runs from heel to toe for ultimate stability and control when on the move. Outsole : The all-court Duralast outsole is harder than the previous generation Rush Pro, and it provides excellent durability and traction. The shoe's Dynamic Fit rating is DF2. This means the Rush Pro 4.5 is built with a 9mm heel-to-toe drop for an optimal balance between cushioning, support, and agility. Color : Black and Ensign Blue Wilson Rush Pro 4.5 blog

items.name: Boom MP 2024 Mint Tennis Racquet
items.description: The HEAD Boom MP Mint 2024 Tennis Racquet expands the Auxetic construction to the end of the handle. The technology improves the feel and stability of the racquet at contact. Players can confidently go after the ball by delivering ideal feedback with improved vibration dampening. The Boom MP's cross-section features a Morph Beam design, which pairs an elongated shaft for flex and feel with a thicker hoop section for greater access to power and stability. The racquet has a different head shape than the other HEAD performance frames and it is designed with a uniform string pattern to make the string bed perform more consistently. HEAD's Graphene Inside tech remains at the 12, 9, and 3 o'clock positions and within the throat to deliver stability and ball speed. The Boom MP is designed to help players of all abilities create more power with less effort. The Boom MP is endorsed on tour by Coco Gauff . For 2024, the Boom has improved comfort and the same point finishing power as the previous version. String Recommendation: Lynx Touch at 52 pounds Features : - Auxetic 2.0 adds the technology to the end of the grip for ultimate feedback. - Morph Beam design blends flex, feel, and power. -Unique sensation at contact is comfortable without feeling flimsy. -Special mint cosmetic! (Same specifications as the Boom MP 2024)

items.name: Instinct MP 2025 Tennis Racquet
items.description: The HEAD Instinct MP 2025 Tennis Racquet is built with Auxetic technology for a refined impact feel. The cross-section has been specifically designed to help players generate easy power from all areas of the court. The Graphene 360+ Instinct MP offers a very dampened feel at contact, and more power than the Speed, Gravity, or Prestige lines. At 10.6 ounces unstrung , the Instinct MP is easy to whip around on groundstrokes. The 16x19 string pattern offers a predictable response, and the slightly head light balance will be very comfortable for players with medium to medium-fast swings. For 2025, HEAD gives the Instinct a more aggressive cosmetic and incredible value for a performance tennis racquet. String Recommendation: Lynx Touch at 52 pounds Blog : HEAD Instinct 2025 Features : -Auxetic for refined impact feel. -Cross section designed for easy power. -Aggressive new cosmetic fits the Instinct MPs first strike characteristics.

items.name: Boom Team L 2024 Tennis Racquet
items.description: The HEAD Boom Team L Tennis Racquet is a brand-new model in the Boom lineup. Like the other 2024 Boom models, the Team L features an Auxetic construction within the racquet bridge and the end of the handle. The result is an enhanced sensational feel. The cross-section features a Morph Beam design, which pairs an elongated shaft for flex and feel with a thicker hoop section for greater access to power and stability. The racquet has a different head shape than the other HEAD performance frames and it is designed with a Uniform String Pattern to make the string bed perform more consistently. HEAD's Graphene Inside tech remains at the 12, 9, and 3 o'clock positions, as well as within the throat to deliver stability and ball speed. The Team L has the largest head size of any Boom model at 107 square inches, and the beam is slightly thicker for added stability. The extended length provides more power and spin potential, but the 9.2-ounce unstrung weight keeps the racquet very maneuverable. This model brings all the great power and feel of the Boom to beginner players who want a fun racquet that is easy to use. String Recommendation: HEAD Velocity MLT at 55 pounds Features : - Auxetic 2.0 adds the technology to the end of the grip for ultimate feedback. - Morph Beam design blends flex, feel, and power. -Oversized head and xxtended length make it easy to hit with power. -Thicker beam and larger head for greater forgiveness.

High-performance EVA foam is strategically built into the midsole of the shoe, enhancing cushion and comfort while boosting rebound so that you can chase down every wide angle and every drop shot. A soft, breathable upper is paired with a sturdy Starting Bloc plate underfoot to help make those lateral movements stable and precise. The shoe's outsole is made with Michelin-grade rubber material , amplifying both durability and grip on the court surface. This shoe is an excellent choice for speed-focused players who like to cover every inch of the court and still have time to hit a nasty shot. Outsole : The Michelin Performance outsole delivers superior traction and durability on all court surfaces.

items.description: Note: These shoes designed for clay courts. ASICS ' Women's Solution Speed FF 3 Clay Tennis Shoe is ASICS' fastest tennis shoe. This outsole is designed for Clay court play Color: Light Ube and Indigo Fog

items.name: Women's THE ROGER Pro 2 Tennis Shoes All White
items.description: THE ROGER Pro 2 Women's Tennis Shoe by On is the second tennis shoe from On and Roger Federer . An abrasion-resistant mesh upper and perforated tongue give THE ROGER Pro 2 unmatched airflow in a lightweight package. So when the game heats up, you can move like lightning. On created a shoe that features some of the brands' signature technology, but with some new additions to be sure it holds up to rigorous lateral movement on the tennis court. To maintain stability, THE ROGER Pro is built with a solid midsole made from high-density, high-performance foam . The unit extends on the lateral side of the shoe, increasing the footbed size to add stability. A midfoot cage keeps the foot locked in during intense play, and a curved edge along the outsole helps deliver a smooth weight transfer into every ball. A 100% carbon fiber Speedboard was used in the shoes. The board absorbs impact during landing, and it returns energy for ideal balance on the next step. THE ROGER Pro 2 has improved stability, agility, and durability over the previous version. The shoe is worn on tour by world number 1 Iga Swiatek . *These shoes run slightly short. Our playtesters recommend ordering up 1/2 size for extra length in the toe box. Activity : Tennis Width : B Length : Short Upper : Upgraded engineered mesh upper is breathable and abrasion-resistant for comfort and durability. Internal half-bootie for a lockdown fit. Perforated tongue for better breathability. Reinforced rubber toe cap for added durability and the lateral TPU clip and upper overlays for structure and support. Midsole: Made from a solid high-density, high-performance foam. 100% carbon fiber Speedboard for energy return and agility. Molded heel counter for improved foot lockdown. 8mm heel-toe drop Outsole : The open herringbone tread pattern for uncompromising traction. Engineered for hard court tennis. Color : All White

items.name: Men's Jet Mach 4 Spectra All Court Tennis Shoes
items.description: In the heat of battle, find confidence in the speed-focused Babolat Jet Mach 4 Spectra Tennis Shoes . Babolat gave this Jet Mach 4 a look inspired by the architecture, bright lights, and energy of NYC. Built upon the technologies that made the Jet Mach 3 shoes a superb option for speedsters, the Jet Mach 4 is scientifically proven to enhance speed, agility, and quick stops. High-performance EVA foam is strategically built into the midsole of the shoe, enhancing cushion and comfort while boosting rebound so that you can chase down every wide angle and every drop shot. A soft, breathable upper is paired with a sturdy Starting Bloc plate underfoot to help make those lateral movements stable and precise. The shoe's outsole is made with Michelin-grade rubber material , amplifying both durability and grip on the court surface. This shoe is an excellent choice for speed-focused players who like to cover every inch of the court and still have time to hit a nasty shot. Upper : The one-piece upper is designed to offer a comfortable, breathable, and ergonomic experience. Material around the toe and medial forefoot enhances durability. Midsole : The EVA midsole is soft and responsive, designed to enhance rebound during every rally. Outsole : The Michelin Performance outsole delivers superior traction and durability on all court surfaces.

items.name: TF40 290 16M V3 Tennis Racquet
items.description: Tecnifibre introduces an updated TF40 290 16M V3 Tennis Racquet. This model is the lightest TF40 model and it is the most mobile in the line. Tecnifibre borrowed from the beam design of the T-Fights and constructed the RS Sharp Section . The frame is thinner, and more squared off than the T-Fight series for greater flex at impact. To produce a classic and comfortable response, the TF40 models are filled with foam. The foam absorbs racquet vibration to enhance the feel of the ball. Though the TF40 290 is designed for the best players in the world, the grommets are wider and longer to make the string bed more powerful and forgiving. The TF40 290 features a medium flex, a 21.7-millimeter beam, and a 16x19 string pattern. At only 10.2 ounces unstrung, the frame can help aggressive intermediates and advanced ball strikers attack with greater control. The new cosmetic brings a tech camo look to the brand's classic white color. With the more open string pattern, the TF40 290 16M is an ideal choice for an athlete with solid strokes who wants a classic feel but with modern performance. Features : -RS Sharp Section blends a precise feel with more punch. -16x19 string pattern means easier access to spin. -Foam filled means vibration absorption. -Lightweight for added mobility.

items.description: Final Sale — This item is not eligible for returns or exchanges. *Our playtesters recommend ordering 1/2 size up. Lotto Women's Mirage 100 Speed Tennis Shoes are designed to be light and flexible for a fast and agile feel on matchday. These shoes also keep support, stability, and comfort in mind to reduce your risk of injury, and provide an exceptional on-court experience. Additional Shoelaces Included! Upper : The nylon and polyurethane upper combines with a Kurim rubber anti-abrasion toe cap for lightweight breathability, support, and protection. Soft padding around the heel and in the tongue provides additional comfort. Heel Control technology ensures correct heel support and control. Insole: The Mirage 100 Speed is unique among tennis shoes in that it comes with two pairs of Ortholite insoles. They come in different thicknesses so you can customize your fit. Midsole : EVA provides support and comfort. Enerturn technology absorbs shock through a multiple-density elastic material and returns it to the player. Syn-Pulse between the midsole and outsole provides optimal cushioning, energy return, and stability. Puntoflex allows the foot to flex correctly and results in an elastic return. items.name: Men's GEL-Resolution X Tennis Shoes Digital Sakura and White
items.description: The ASICS Men's GEL-RESOLUTION® X Tennis Shoes create advanced stability and cushioning for players who like to control the court from the baseline. DYNALACING™ technology has been strategically designed to hold when extra support is needed. This allows you to experience a locked-in feel when making quick transitions. There's also a two-piece midsole design that helps improve stability when your foot lands on the court. The locked-in feel is ideal when making quick transitions, and DYNAWALL™ technology in the midsole now extends into the heel for added stability during lateral movements. It's a functional feature effective when you're running covering both sides of the baseline. The full-length outsole and separated heel help produce a more stable landing for quicker recovery in between shots. The GEL-RESOLUTION® X brings plenty of new tech to the table, but most importantly, the shoe delivers all-day comfort. 6-month outsole warranty Worn on Tour by Matteo Berrettini and Taylor Fritz Fit Note : The GEL-RESOLUTON® X shoe has a more spacious fit than previous versions. If you’re upgrading from the GEL-RESOLUTION® 9 shoe, you may prefer sizing down a half size. Review Blog: New Year's Resolution Upper: FLEXION FIT ® provides form-fitting support, while DYNAWALL™ technology adds stability to the midfoot and heel section during lateral movements. The PGUARD ™ toe protector provides additional security against excessive wear. DYNAWRAP integrates with the laces to create additional stability when you need it most. The new DYNALACING™ system adds four additional eyelets on the lateral side of each shoe to help you get a customized, locked-in fit. Insole: Ortholite insoles offer long-term cushioning, breathability, and moisture management. Midsole: Forefoot GEL™ technology Improves impact absorption and creates a softer feeling at footstrike Outsole: The AHAR® Plus Outsole is strategically positioned in critical areas for durability. Color : Digital Sakura and White

items.name: Men's GEL-Resolution X Tennis Shoes Black and Aurora Green
items.description: The ASICS Men's GEL-RESOLUTION® X Tennis Shoes create advanced stability and cushioning for players who like to control the court from the baseline. DYNALACING™ technology has been strategically designed to hold when extra support is needed. This allows you to experience a locked-in feel when making quick transitions. There's also a two-piece midsole design that helps improve stability when your foot lands on the court. The locked-in feel is ideal when making quick transitions, and DYNAWALL™ technology in the midsole now extends into the heel for added stability during lateral movements. It's a functional feature effective when you're running covering both sides of the baseline. The full-length outsole and separated heel help produce a more stable landing for quicker recovery in between shots. The GEL-RESOLUTION® X brings plenty of new tech to the table, but most importantly, the shoe delivers all-day comfort. 6-month outsole warranty Worn on Tour by Matteo Berrettini and Taylor Fritz Fit Note : The GEL-RESOLUTON® X shoe has a more spacious fit than previous versions. If you’re upgrading from the GEL-RESOLUTION® 9 shoe, you may prefer sizing down a half size. Review Blog: New Year's Resolution Upper: FLEXION FIT ® provides form-fitting support, while DYNAWALL™ technology adds stability to the midfoot and heel section during lateral movements. The PGUARD ™ toe protector provides additional security against excessive wear. DYNAWRAP integrates with the laces to create additional stability when you need it most. The new DYNALACING™ system adds four additional eyelets on the lateral side of each shoe to help you get a customized, locked-in fit. Insole: Ortholite insoles offer long-term cushioning, breathability, and moisture management. Midsole: Forefoot GEL™ technology Improves impact absorption and creates a softer feeling at footstrike Outsole: The AHAR® Plus Outsole is strategically positioned in critical areas for durability. Color : Black and Aurora Green

items.name: Women's Court FF 3 Tennis Shoes White and Sky
items.description: ASICS Women's Court FF 3 Tennis Shoes are designed to help you swing stronger and recover quicker between shots, allowing you to take your game to the next level. By increasing the outsole’s contact area, the shoe creates a stable landing and reduces the load placed on the body. The FF 3's updated TWISTRUSS™ system helps with recovery from the previous shot, and it adds stability and quickness when pursuing the next ball. Upper : The PU covered upper features a proprietary construction designed to provide form-fitting comfort without sacrificing support. ASICS' MONO-SOCK® technology fit system utilizes an elastic internal sleeve for a "sock-like" fit. Insole : A removable OrthoLite™ sockliner improves comfort and performance. Midsole : FlyteFoam® midsole technology is made up of organic "super fibers" that provide superior cushioning and bounce back in a lightweight package. The rear and forefoot GEL™ technology cushioning system further reduces the amount of shock experienced. Outsole : The separated TWISTRUSS™ support system accounts for the foot's difference in elevation by allowing natural torsional deformation. Updated AHAR™ outsole material improves durability and traction. The Court FF 3 boasts increased contact area at the heel to provide better stability when landing, and smoother transitions for a more powerful swinging motion. Color : White and Sky

items.name: Women's GEL-Resolution X Tennis Shoes White and Bluebell
items.description: The ASICS Women's GEL-RESOLUTION® X Tennis Shoes create advanced stability and cushioning for players who like to control the court from the baseline. DYNALACING™ technology has been strategically designed to hold when extra support is needed. This allows you to experience a locked-in feel when making quick transitions. A two-piece midsole design also helps improve stability when your foot lands on the court. The locked-in feel is ideal when making quick transitions, and DYNAWALL™ technology in the midsole now extends into the heel for added stability during lateral movements. It's a functional feature effective when you're running covering both sides of the baseline. The full-length outsole and separated heel help produce a more stable landing for quicker recovery in between shots. The GEL-RESOLUTION® X improves on the Gel-Resolution 9 with improved support and stability. But most importantly the shoe delivers all-day comfort. 6-month outsole warranty Worn on Tour by Jasmine Paolini Review Blog: New Year's Resolution Upper: FLEXION FIT ® provides form-fitting support, while DYNAWALL™ technology adds stability to the midfoot and heel section during lateral movements. The PGUARD ™ toe protector provides additional security against excessive wear. DYNAWRAP integrates with the laces to create additional stability when you need it most. The new DYNALACING™ system adds four additional eyelets on the lateral side of each shoe to help you get a customized, locked-in fit. Insole: Ortholite insoles offer long-term cushioning, breathability, and moisture management. Midsole: Forefoot GEL™ technology Improves impact absorption and creates a softer feeling at footstrike Outsole: The AHAR® Plus Outsole is strategically positioned in critical areas for durability. Color : White and Bluebell

items.name: Women's GEL-Resolution X Tennis Shoes White and Morganite
items.description: The ASICS Women's GEL-RESOLUTION® X Tennis Shoes create advanced stability and cushioning for players who like to control the court from the baseline. DYNALACING™ technology has been strategically designed to hold when extra support is needed. This allows you to experience a locked-in feel when making quick transitions. A two-piece midsole design also helps improve stability when your foot lands on the court. The locked-in feel is ideal when making quick transitions, and DYNAWALL™ technology in the midsole now extends into the heel for added stability during lateral movements. It's a functional feature effective when you're running covering both sides of the baseline. The full-length outsole and separated heel help produce a more stable landing for quicker recovery in between shots. The GEL-RESOLUTION® X improves on the Gel-Resolution 9 with improved support and stability. But most importantly the shoe delivers all-day comfort. 6-month outsole warranty Worn on Tour by Jasmine Paolini Review Blog: New Year's Resolution Upper: FLEXION FIT ® provides form-fitting support, while DYNAWALL™ technology adds stability to the midfoot and heel section during lateral movements. The PGUARD ™ toe protector provides additional security against excessive wear. DYNAWRAP integrates with the laces to create additional stability when you need it most. The new DYNALACING™ system adds four additional eyelets on the lateral side of each shoe to help you get a customized, locked-in fit. Insole: Ortholite insoles offer long-term cushioning, breathability, and moisture management. Midsole: Forefoot GEL™ technology Improves impact absorption and creates a softer feeling at footstrike Outsole: The AHAR® Plus Outsole is strategically positioned in critical areas for durability. Color : White and Morganite

items.name: Women's CLAY Court GEL-Resolution X Tennis Shoes Sky and Grey Blue
items.description: Note: These shoes designed for clay courts. The ASICS Women's GEL-RESOLUTION® X CLAY Tennis Shoes create advanced stability and cushioning for players who like to control the court from the baseline. DYNALACING™ technology has been strategically designed to hold when extra support is needed. This allows you to experience a locked-in feel when making quick transitions. A two-piece midsole design also helps improve stability when your foot lands on the court. The locked-in feel is ideal when making quick transitions, and DYNAWALL™ technology in the midsole now extends into the heel for added stability during lateral movements. It's a functional feature effective when you're running covering both sides of the baseline. The full-length outsole and separated heel help produce a more stable landing for quicker recovery in between shots. The GEL-RESOLUTION® X improves on the Gel-Resolution 9 with improved support and stability. But most importantly the shoe delivers all-day comfort. Worn on Tour by Jasmine Paolini Review Blog: New Year's Resolution Upper: FLEXION FIT ® provides form-fitting support, while DYNAWALL™ technology adds stability to the midfoot and heel section during lateral movements. The PGUARD ™ toe protector provides additional security against excessive wear. DYNAWRAP integrates with the laces to create additional stability when you need it most. The new DYNALACING™ system adds four additional eyelets on the lateral side of each shoe to help you get a customized, locked-in fit. Insole: Ortholite insoles offer long-term cushioning, breathability, and moisture management. Midsole: Forefoot GEL™ technology Improves impact absorption and creates a softer feeling at footstrike Outsole: The AHAR® Plus Outsole is strategically positioned in critical areas for durability. Color : Sky and Grey Blue

items.name: Lynx Tour Tennis String Reel
items.description: HEAD updates their polyester offerings with the new Lynx Tour Tennis String Reel . While the other strings in the Lynx family play a little bit more muted and powerful for a polyester, Lynx Tour is all about spin and control. The string has a subtle, six-sided profile to help players create more spin, and HEAD created a new co-polymer mixture to up the comfort factor. String Lynx Tour in the mains and crosses to up control and spin potential. The string also works well in a hybrid with a softer multifilament like HEAD Velocity or Reflex. Our playtesters noted that Lynx Tour had excellent control, even when strung at a lower tension.. Construction : Co-polyester mono-filament (6 sided) Color : Champagne | Grey Gauge : 16 G / 1.30 mm | 17 G / 1.25 mm Length : 660 ft / 200 m Features: -Six edge construction for spin -Head's most spin-friendly polyester -Use 17 G for more spin, and 16G for more durability

items.name: Women's Jet Mach 4 All Court Tennis Shoes Cream and Lavender
items.description: In the heat of battle, find confidence in the speed-focused Babolat Jet Mach 4 Tennis Shoes . Built upon the technologies that made the Jet Mach 3 shoes a superb option for speedsters, the Jet Mach 4 is scientifically proven to enhance speed, agility, and quick stops. High-performance EVA foam is strategically built into the midsole of the shoe, enhancing cushion and comfort while boosting rebound so that you can chase down every wide angle and every drop shot. A soft, breathable upper is paired with a sturdy Starting Bloc plate underfoot to help make those lateral movements stable and precise. The shoe's outsole is made with Michelin-grade rubber material , amplifying both durability and grip on the court surface. This shoe is an excellent choice for speed-focused players who like to cover every inch of the court and still have time to hit a nasty shot. Upper : The one-piece upper is designed to offer a comfortable, breathable, and ergonomic experience. Material around the toe and medial forefoot enhances durability. Midsole : The EVA midsole is soft and responsive, designed to enhance rebound during every rally. Outsole : The Michelin Performance outsole delivers superior traction and durability on all court surfaces.

items.name: Women's Power Cushion Fusionrev 5 Tennis Shoes Indigo Marine
items.description: The new Yonex Women's FUSIONREV 5 tennis shoes maintain the comfortable characteristics of popular past models but integrate several updates to provide more stability and a closer-to-the-court fit. Version 5 gets the light and soft msLITE X midsole for bouncy support from below along with Power Cushion+. The Durable Skin supports the foot from above. Additionally, The TPU shank is wider and it enhances stability to allow for natural movement during agile footwork. Overall, the Fusionrev 5 tennis shoe does a phenomenal job of providing competitive tennis players with a comfortable, responsive, and high-performance matchday shoe . Upper: The updated Flexion Upper arranges the shoelaces in an asymmetrical pattern to prevent the buildup of excess pressure on the top of the foot. Inside, the flexible Inner Bootie runs from the metatarsal to the heel and provides adaptive support as well as a gentler fit. An updated "Fusion Wing" is placed on the forefoot, and the updated inner and outer wings are designed for active support and provide stability; unlocking quick lateral footwork. Durable Skin is an adaptable material that wraps over the top of the shoe. It supports agile footwork through its balance between stability and flexibility. Insole : Synchro-Fit Insole provides a closer fit between the shoe and the foot. Midsole: msLITE X foam runs along the length of the midsole, while Power Cushion+ is positioned beneath the forefoot and heel. This combination ensures superior shock absorption and energy return. The new Power Graphite sheet has been inserted at the midfoot for increased stability, support, and response. Outsole: A newly designed one-piece outsole has been implemented in the shoe that helps to improve your gripping and stability. It also pairs with the midsole technology beautifully to drastically improve your push-off and strength during response. Color: Indigo Marine For information regarding sizes, please refer to our sizing chart . Learn more about Yonex's tennis shoe technologies here .

items.name: Men's GEL-Resolution X Tennis Shoes White and Aurora Green
items.description: The ASICS Men's GEL-RESOLUTION® X Tennis Shoes create advanced stability and cushioning for players who like to control the court from the baseline. DYNALACING™ technology has been strategically designed to hold when extra support is needed. This allows you to experience a locked-in feel when making quick transitions. There's also a two-piece midsole design that helps improve stability when your foot lands on the court. The locked-in feel is ideal when making quick transitions, and DYNAWALL™ technology in the midsole now extends into the heel for added stability during lateral movements. It's a functional feature effective when you're running covering both sides of the baseline. The full-length outsole and separated heel help produce a more stable landing for quicker recovery in between shots. The GEL-RESOLUTION® X brings plenty of new tech to the table, but most importantly, the shoe delivers all-day comfort. 6-month outsole warranty Worn on Tour by Matteo Berrettini and Taylor Fritz Fit Note : The GEL-RESOLUTON® X shoe has a more spacious fit than previous versions. If you’re upgrading from the GEL-RESOLUTION® 9 shoe, you may prefer sizing down a half size. Review Blog: New Year's Resolution Upper: FLEXION FIT ® provides form-fitting support, while DYNAWALL™ technology adds stability to the midfoot and heel section during lateral movements. The PGUARD ™ toe protector provides additional security against excessive wear. DYNAWRAP integrates with the laces to create additional stability when you need it most. The new DYNALACING™ system adds four additional eyelets on the lateral side of each shoe to help you get a customized, locked-in fit. Insole: Ortholite insoles offer long-term cushioning, breathability, and moisture management. Midsole: Forefoot GEL™ technology Improves impact absorption and creates a softer feeling at footstrike Outsole: The AHAR® Plus Outsole is strategically positioned in critical areas for durability. Color : White and Aurora Green

items.name: Men's Jet Mach 4 All Court Tennis Shoes Dark Blue and White
items.description: In the heat of battle, find confidence in the speed-focused Babolat Jet Mach 4 Tennis Shoes . Built upon the technologies that made the Jet Mach 3 shoes a superb option for speedsters, the Jet Mach 4 is scientifically proven to enhance speed, agility, and quick stops. High-performance EVA foam is strategically built into the midsole of the shoe, enhancing cushion and comfort while boosting rebound so that you can chase down every wide angle and every drop shot. A soft, breathable upper is paired with a sturdy Starting Bloc plate underfoot to help make those lateral movements stable and precise. The shoe's outsole is made with Michelin-grade rubber material , amplifying both durability and grip on the court surface. This shoe is an excellent choice for speed-focused players who like to cover every inch of the court and still have time to hit a nasty shot. Upper : The one-piece upper is designed to offer a comfortable, breathable, and ergonomic experience. Material around the toe and medial forefoot enhances durability. Midsole : The EVA midsole is soft and responsive, designed to enhance rebound during every rally. Outsole : The Michelin Performance outsole delivers superior traction and durability on all court surfaces.

items.name: TF40 315 16M V3 Tennis Racquet
items.description: Tecnifibre introduces an updated TF40 315 16M V3 Tennis Racquet , this time with an open string pattern! The previous TF40s were a favorite of advanced players who require absolute precision and feel to succeed on the court. With the new model, Tecnifibre borrowed from the beam design of the T-Fights and constructed the RS Sharp Section . The frame is thinner, and more squared off than the T-Fight series for greater flex at impact. To produce a classic and comfortable response, the TF40 models are filled with foam . The foam absorbs racquet vibration to enhance the feel for the ball. Though the TF40 315 is designed for the best players in the world, the grommets are wider and longer to make the string bed more powerful and forgiving. The TF40 315 features a medium flex, a 21.7-millimeter beam, and a 16x19 string pattern. At 11.1 ounces unstrung, the frame can help advanced ball strikers attack with tour-level stability. The new cosmetic brings a tech camo to the classic white design. With the more open string pattern, the TF40 315 16M V3 is ideal for an elite player who values stability, feel, and spin. Features : -RS Sharp Section blends a precise feel with more punch. -16x19 string pattern means easier access to spin. -Foam filled means vibration absorption. -11.1 ounces unstrung, and the most headlight of any TF40 racquet.

items.name: Women's Propulse Storm All Court Tennis Shoes White and Silver
items.description: The Babolat Women's Propulse Storm All Court Tennis Shoe delivers the stability and durability to keep you moving with confidence. Built for players who put heavy demands on their shoes through aggressive slides and hard stops, the Propulse Storm features a tough synthetic upper reinforced by Pro Shield + Storm technology, which places two molded rubber protectors from the midfoot all the way to the toes. These protectors guard against the friction and abrasion that break down lesser shoes, while an abrasion-resistant lacing system adds even more longevity to the forefoot area. Between the midsole and upper, S-Block Storm technology increases lateral support and ground contact, keeping your movements powerful and controlled through fast changes of direction. Underfoot, a molded OrthoLite insole follows the natural contours of the foot for cushioning and breathability that last through long matches and practice sessions. This shoe is an excellent choice for hard-hitting baseliners and aggressive movers who need their footwear to hold up match after match. Upper : The ultra-resistant synthetic upper provides a precise, supportive fit, with molded rubber reinforcements from the midfoot to the toes for long-lasting durability. Midsole : The S-Block Storm reinforcement piece sits between the midsole and upper to increase lateral stability and ground anchoring during hard directional changes. Outsole : Developed with Michelin, the Michelin Premium Tennis outsole uses the most durable rubber composition in the Babolat lineup, delivering increased resistance and reliable grip on all court surfaces.

items.name: Women's Jet Mach 4 All Court Tennis Shoes White and Silver
items.description: In the heat of battle, find confidence in the speed-focused Babolat Jet Mach 4 Tennis Shoes . Built upon the technologies that made the Jet Mach 3 shoes a superb option for speedsters, the Jet Mach 4 is scientifically proven to enhance speed, agility, and quick stops. High-performance EVA foam is strategically built into the midsole of the shoe, enhancing cushion and comfort while boosting rebound so that you can chase down every wide angle and every drop shot. A soft, breathable upper is paired with a sturdy Starting Bloc plate underfoot to help make those lateral movements stable and precise. The shoe's outsole is made with Michelin-grade rubber material , amplifying both durability and grip on the court surface. This shoe is an excellent choice for speed-focused players who like to cover every inch of the court and still have time to hit a nasty shot. Outsole : The Michelin Performance outsole delivers superior traction and durability on all court surfaces.

The sophisticated two-piece midsole construction optimizes comfort and stability with every court contact, ensuring confident landings during intense rallies. DYNAWALL™ technology extends through the heel area, providing crucial lateral stability when covering the baseline and executing wide court coverage. This functional design proves essential when tracking down shots and maintaining court position during extended exchanges. The elevated medial collar delivers additional support during sharp directional cuts and rapid movement changes that define effective padel play. items.name: Men's Sprint Pro 4.0 Tennis Shoes Chalk White and Dark Grey
items.description: HEAD Men’s Sprint Pro 4.0 Tennis Shoes are the ideal blend of lightweight comfort, stability, and durability for players who demand top-tier performance on any court surface. Built on the success of its predecessor, this updated model refines its design to offer an even more responsive feel without sacrificing support. To enhance stability during aggressive lateral movements, HEAD incorporates the Deltastrap system along with the Heel Stabilizer 180 , a TPU brace that locks the foot in place for a secure, confident feel. Durability is also a highlight of this shoe, thanks to the Head Abrasion outsole. Whether you're sliding on hard courts or making quick transitions on clay, this shoe is built to last while maintaining excellent traction. Upper : Lightweight, breathable mesh paired with comfortable tongue and collar padding, and cushioned molded sock liner. Midsole : Triple density midsole. Ventilated 3D-anti torsion shank with minimal heel-to-toe offset, and a higher heel for enhanced cushioning. Outsole : Hybrid outsole profile built for all courts. Special durability zones for hardcourt players, and open tread for enhanced grip on any surface. Ventilation holes for better breathability.

items.name: Men's CLAY Court THE ROGER Pro 2 Tennis Shoes Ice and Pink
items.description: Note: These shoes designed for clay courts. THE ROGER Pro 2 Men's Clay Tennis Shoe by On is the second tennis shoe from On and Roger Federer . An abrasion-resistant mesh upper and perforated tongue give THE ROGER Pro 2 unmatched airflow in a lightweight package. So when the game heats up, you can move like lightning. On created a shoe that features some of the brands' signature technology, but with some new additions to be sure it holds up to rigorous lateral movement on the tennis court. To maintain stability, THE ROGER Pro is built with a solid midsole made from high-density, high-performance foam . The unit extends on the lateral side of the shoe, increasing the footbed size to add stability. A midfoot cage keeps the foot locked in during intense play, and a curved edge along the outsole helps deliver a smooth weight transfer into every ball. A 100% carbon fiber Speedboard was used in the shoes. The board absorbs impact during landing, returning energy for ideal balance on the next step. THE ROGER Pro 2 has improved stability, agility, and durability over the previous version. The shoe is worn on tour by world number 1, Iga Swiatek . *These shoes run slightly short. Our playtesters recommend ordering up 1/2 size for extra length in the toe box. Midsole: Made from a solid high-density, high-performance foam.100% carbon fiber Speedboard for energy return and agility. Molded heel counter for improved foot lockdown. Outsole : The open herringbone tread pattern for uncompromising traction. This shoe is designed for CLAY COURT play. Color : Ice and Pink

items.name: RIP Control 16G Tennis String Black
items.description: One of the more unique string constructions around, Head RIP Control 16 is a blatant advertisement for its best property, control. Utilizing a central core of standard nylon fibers, this string provides a surprisingly elastic response to go along with its incredible precision. The most unique feature of RIP Control is the application of an outer sheath of polyolefin ribbons made famous by IsoSpeed . These thin, flat ribbons are braided around the central core and provide plenty of control and texture for additional spin generation. With solid durability, these strings are a great option for baseline players seeking control and spin without moving to a very stiff string. The feel is crisp, while still providing enough feel for those trips towards the net. items.name: Unisex LUX TEMPO Pickleball Shoes White and Grey
items.description: The Nox LUX TEMPO Pickleball Shoes protect your body while maximizing your game. Clinically certified and lab-tested, this shoe reduces injury risk with technologies designed specifically for pickleball's explosive movements and quick direction changes. AGG Technology optimizes your heel-to-toe positioning so you can get into the ready position faster, start quicker, and play longer without calf strain. Heel Frame support keeps your ankles stable during hard lateral cuts, while the herringbone outsole grips any court surface for confident stops and starts. *Listed in men's sizes; women should order 1.5 sizes smaller for the equivalent women's size (e.g. if you are a women's size 10, then you are a men's size 8.5). Upper: Breathable materials keep feet cool through long matches. AbraXone lateral reinforcement adds durability and stability exactly where aggressive pickleball movement creates the most wear and stress on the shoe. Midsole: Dual-layer EVA foam and phylon construction delivers responsive cushioning that returns energy with every step. Your legs stay fresher longer because the midsole absorbs impact while the antimicrobial Comfort Foam insole prevents odors and maintains a lightweight feel. Outsole: Herringbone tread with strategically placed studs grips hard for explosive movements and reliable traction on all court surfaces. The wide heel base increases stability during lateral movements, reducing the risk of ankle rolls when you're stretching for that corner shot. Best For: Players who want clinically proven joint protection without sacrificing performance, competitive athletes seeking maximum stability and grip, and anyone looking to play longer with less fatigue and injury risk.

Midsole : Midfoot cushioning sits higher off the court surface to enhance comfort. Outsole : High-abrasion rubber for traction on multiple surfaces.

items.description: This shoe fits small; we recommend ordering a half-size up. If normally size 8, order a size 8.5. The medial toe has extra rubber to help withstand excessive wear and tear and the forefoot is protected with high-abrasion rubber for added traction. The traditional U-throat design provides easy entry and adjustment, and an extra padded tongue is constructed with breathable mesh for cool comfort. Upper : Synthetic Cage for adaptive containment. Extra-padded mesh tongue for breathability and comfort. A padded ankle collar helps create a locked-in fit. Midsole : Zoom Air unit in the heel for a comfortable ride. Outsole : High-abrasion rubber located in the forefoot enhances durability and traction. This outsole is designed for hard court surfaces.

items.name: Women's Vapor Lite 3 Tennis Shoes Pink Smoke and White
items.description: The Nike Women's Vapor Lite 3 Tennis Shoe shares a similar aesthetic to the Vapor 12 and Vapor Pro 3 models. While it is not as stable and supportive as those two models, the Vapor Lite 3 offers plush underfoot cushioning with almost no break-in period. Version 3 can fit multiple foot types and features a midsole designed with dual-density foam for support and comfort. The shoe has improved the durability on the medial side of the toebox, and while it sits a little higher off the court surface than the other Vapors, it has a good amount of flex to adapt to on-court movements. The Vapor Lite 3 is a good choice for a casual tennis player seeking comfort, style, and flexibility in a sub-$100 option. Upper : The upper material comprises a breathable sandwich mesh with bolstered durability at the toe. The padded tongue and traditional lacing system provide easy entry and out-of-the-box comfort. Reinforced heel and forefoot for support Midsole : A spongy Phylon foam provides a slightly higher and more cushioned ride. Outsole : The new Hart rubber outsole and toe tip for improved durability and protection in high wear zones. This model features an outsole design for play on hard courts.

items.name: Women's Clay Court Zoom Vapor 12 Tennis Shoes Pink Smoke and White
items.description: Note : This is a clay court shoe. The Nike Paris Women's CLAY Court Zoom Vapor 12 Tennis Shoes are the latest evolution of one of the sport's best-selling styles. The Vapor 12 is built for speed without compromising on comfort and stability. The Zoom Air unit delivers low-profile cushioning in the heel for impact protection and rebound. The lateral stability is bolstered with a heel-to-toe TPU foot frame, which wraps the midfoot for lightweight support during aggressive cuts. The Vapor 12 utilizes the Adaptive fit system which encompasses a midfoot band that locks the foot into place and creates confidence for every on-court movement. The Vapor 12 is incredibly popular among the world's best tennis players, and for a lightweight speed and agility shoe, it is hard to beat. Upper : Engineered Mesh with CAST PU in high-wear areas for added durability. Adaptive midfoot band for a lock-down fit. Midsole : Zoom Air unit in the heel for low-profile cushioning. Full-length TPU foot frame and midfoot shank for lightweight stability. A foam layer between the rubber and the plastic plate for added spring. Outsole : New rubber Herringbone-patterned outsole for traction on clay courts. The Split Sole design reduces weight without compromising stability.

items.description: The Nike Men's Vapor Lite 3 Tennis Shoe shares a similar aesthetic to the Vapor 12 and Vapor Pro 3 models, and while it is not as stable and supportive as those two models, the Vapor Lite 3 offers plush underfoot cushioning with almost no break-in period. Version 3 can fit multiple foot types and features a midsole designed with dual-density foam for support and comfort. The shoe has improved the durability on the medial side of the toebox, and while it sits a little higher off the court surface than the other Vapors, it has a good amount of flex to adapt to on-court movements. The Vapor Lite 3 is a good choice for a casual tennis player who wants comfort, style, and flexibility in a sub $100 option. Upper : The upper material comprises a breathable sandwich mesh with bolstered durability at the toe. The padded tongue and traditional lacing system provide easy entry and out-of-the-box comfort. Outsole : The new Hart rubber outsole and toe tip for improved durability and protection in high wear zones. This model features an outsole design for play on hard courts.

items.description: Note: These shoes designed for clay courts. The Nike Men's CLAY Court Paris Air Zoom Vapor Pro 3 Tennis Shoe updates one of the most popular shoe designs used on the pro tour. items.name: Men's London Zoom Vapor 12 Hypersmash Tennis Shoes Gorge Green and White
items.description: The Nike Men's London Zoom Vapor 12 Hypersmash Tennis Shoes are the latest evolution of one of the sport's best-selling styles. The Vapor 12 is built for speed without compromising on comfort and stability. The Zoom Air unit delivers low-profile cushioning in the heel for impact protection and rebound. The lateral stability is bolstered with a heel-to-toe TPU foot frame, which wraps the midfoot for lightweight support during aggressive cuts. The Vapor 12 utilizes the Adaptive fit system, which encompasses a midfoot band that locks the foot into place and creates confidence for every on-court movement. The Vapor 12 is incredibly popular among the world's best tennis players, and for a lightweight speed and agility shoe, it is hard to beat. This special Hypersmash colorway is a tribute to the Hyper Dunk basketball shoe released in 2008. Fit Check: We recommend ordering a half size larger than normal size Upper : Engineered Mesh with CAST PU in high-wear areas for added durability. Adaptive midfoot band for a lock-down fit. Midsole : Zoom Air unit in the heel for low-profile cushioning. Full-length TPU foot frame and midfoot shank for lightweight stability. A foam layer between the rubber and the plastic plate for added spring. Outsole : New rubber Herringbone-patterned outsole for traction on hard courts. The Split Sole design reduces weight without compromising stability.

items.name: Women's London Vapor Pro 3 Premium Tennis Shoes White and Gorge Green
items.description: The Nike Women's London Vapor Pro 3 PRM Tennis Shoe updates one of the most popular shoe designs used on the pro tour. The third iteration of Vapor Pro features a reshaped Zoom Air unit in the forefoot for more responsive cushioning. The midsole design carries over from the previous generation, but a new midfoot band locks the foot down better for enhanced fit and security. The shoe has a redesigned forefoot TPU to increase flex, and a new Hart Rubber compound is on the outsole, upper, toe, and eye stay to protect high-wear areas. Includes a decorative string dampener for your tennis racquet, designed with a strawberries and cream motif. Upper : Durable Mesh for protection and breathable comfort. Hart Rubber reinforced eyestay for added security. Midsole : The soft foam midsole contains a hex Zoom Air unit running throughout the forefoot for responsive cushioning minus the bulk. Outsole : New Hart Rubber compound on the outsole, upper, toe, and eye stay to protect high-wear areas. This shoe is designed for use on hard court surfaces. Read our Nike Vapor Pro 3 Review

items.name: Women's CLAY Court Fusionrev 5 Tennis Shoes Black and White
items.description: Final Sale — This item is not eligible for returns or exchanges. Note: These shoes designed for clay courts. The new Yonex Women's FUSIONREV 5 Clay tennis shoes maintain the comfortable characteristics of popular past models but integrate several updates to provide more stability and a closer-to-the-court fit. Version 5 gets the light and soft msLITE X midsole for bouncy support from below along with Power Cushion+. The Durable Skin supports the foot from above. Additionally, The TPU shank is wider and it enhances stability to allow for natural movement during agile footwork. Overall, the Fusionrev 5 tennis shoe does a phenomenal job of providing competitive tennis players with a comfortable, responsive, and high-performance matchday shoe . Upper: The updated Flexion Upper arranges the shoelaces in an asymmetrical pattern to prevent the buildup of excess pressure on the top of the foot. Inside, the flexible Inner Bootie runs from the metatarsal to the heel and provides adaptive support as well as a gentler fit. An updated "Fusion Wing" is placed on the forefoot, and the updated inner and outer wings are designed for active support and provide stability; unlocking quick lateral footwork. Durable Skin is an adaptable material that wraps over the top of the shoe. It supports agile footwork through its balance between stability and flexibility. Insole : Synchro-Fit Insole provides a closer fit between the shoe and the foot. Midsole: msLITE X foam runs along the length of the midsole, while Power Cushion+ is positioned beneath the forefoot and heel. This combination ensures superior shock absorption and energy return. The new Power Graphite sheet has been inserted at the midfoot for increased stability, support, and response. Outsole: A newly designed one-piece outsole has been implemented in the shoe that helps to improve your gripping and stability. This outsole is designed for Clay court surfaces. Color: Black and White For information regarding sizes, please refer to our sizing chart . Learn more about Yonex's tennis shoe technologies here .

The Fierce has a handle long enough for players who hit a two-handed backhand but still short enough for good maneuverability. The fiberglass face helps with responsiveness and depth, and the single-piece construction enhances feedback. The 13-millimeter thickness provides great power potential.

items.name: Men's Game FF Pickleball Shoes White and Mako Blue
items.description: Both lightweight and flexible, the ASICS Men's GEL-GAME™ FF Pickleball Shoe is multi-functional for all-court players. Preserving its excellent support properties, our focus this season was to improve the shoe's ventilation and flexibility. Upper : Featuring an open mesh design on the upper to improve airflow and keep feet cool, this shoe is complemented with synthetic leather overlays and a PU (polyurethane) film that offers improved stability when making abrupt transitions. Midsole : The TRUSSTIC™ technology in the midsole generates better stability on the court. At the same time, the FLYTEFOAM™ technology in the midsole helps provide lightweight cushioning. Outsole : Improved outsole offers better flexibility and durability.
